title: Analyzing Within-Subject Experiments: Identification, Testing, and Sensitivity
abstract: arXiv:2608.26606v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent work encourages political scientists to move from post-only toward within-subject designs for improved precision from repeated measurements. We formalize a potential-outcomes framework for two-period within-subject designs that allows for unequal allocation and heterogeneous treatment and carryover effects. We characterize the pooled estimator and evaluate the carryover test used to justify pooling. We find: first, pooling identifies the average treatment effect only when the gap in the average carryover effects is zero across the two treatment sequences. The unit-clustered standard error for the pooled estimator is identical to its design-based counterpart. Second, under mild conditions, the carryover test has strictly less power than the average-treatment-effect test with post-only data. translated_title: 分析受试者内设计实验：识别、检验与敏感性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26606v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：近期研究鼓励政治科学家从仅测后设计转向受试者内设计，以提高重复测量的精度。我们为两期受试者内设计构建了一个潜在结果框架，该框架允许非均衡分配、异质性处理效应和携带效应。我们刻画了合并估计量，并评估了用于证明合并合理性的携带效应检验。我们发现：首先，仅当两种处理序列间的平均携带效应差异为零时，合并才能识别平均处理效应。合并估计量的单位聚类标准误与其基于设计的对应标准误相同。其次，在温和条件下，携带效应检验的检验功效严格低于使用仅测后数据的平均处理效应检验。由此产生的两步程序（仅在检验未拒绝后才合并）产生的置信区间通常覆盖不足。当……
tldr: 本文提出并分析了允许异质性和携带效应的两期受试者内设计潜在结果框架，发现合并仅在特定条件下有效，且携带效应检验功效较低，导致两步法置信区间覆盖不足。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes a potential-outcomes framework for two-period within-subject designs with heterogeneous and carryover effects, showing pooling identifies the ATE only under zero carryover gaps, and that the carryover test has lower power, causing undercoverage in two-step procedures.
